en.limits: The quota is valid for 90 days from activation, the model's release or your request approval, whichever is later. It covers real-time inference only (not batch, fine-tuning or deployment). Token Plan and Coding Plan keys don't use the free quota.

Open Model Studio (Singapore) and accept the service agreement; the quota is granted automatically, usually within two hours
Check remaining quota on the model usage page (Free Quota tab)
Turn on "Free Quota Only" to stop the service instead of billing you when the quota runs out
en.end: Quota expires 90 days after activation

en.commercial_use: Not specified on the official page; check the provider's terms.
en.card_required: The free-quota page doesn't say; you must complete your account information before activation.
en.phone_required: Not stated on the official page.
en.region: Singapore region, international deployment scope only
en.conditions: After the quota runs out you're billed pay-as-you-go unless you turn on Free Quota Only.
